query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM listing l
            WHERE l.id = $1
              AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR l.user_id = $2)
              AND ($3 OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM promo_code_listing pl
                  WHERE pl.promo_code_id = $4 AND pl.listing_id = l.id
              ))
        ) as "covered!"
